nodes.label: GDAP Recommended Roles
nodes.rationale: 15 granular Entra roles instead of Global Administrator because GA relationships are not eligible for GDAP auto-extend; v10.1 promoted Billing Administrator, Domain Name Administrator, Global Reader from suggested to required, existing users must remap roles, recreate the CIPP Defaults template, and establish new GDAP relationships (roles cannot be added to an existing relationship)
